<!DOCTYPE html>

<head>

  <title>NDX Invest · 持仓一级 / 二级 / 三级统一原型</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #f5f7f8;
      --surface: #ffffff;
      --surface-soft: #f0f2f3;

      --text: #17212b;
      --text-2: #66788a;
      --text-3: #98a5b2;
      --disabled: #c3cbd2;
      --divider: #e7ebee;

      --brand: #62bfa0;
      --brand-soft: #e7f5ef;

      --profit: #2fa36b;
      --loss: #d95757;

      --buy-soft: #e8f5ee;
      --buy-text: #2f8f69;

      --sell-soft: #f8eceb;
      --sell-text: #c65a57;

      --record-soft: #edf1f5;
      --record-text: #6f7e91;

      --calendar-blue: #5a7fae;
      --fund-radius: 24px;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100%;
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family:
        -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont,
        "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text",
        "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei",
        "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overscroll-behavior: none;
    }

    body {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    button { font: inherit; }

    .app {
      width: min(100%, 430px);
      height: 100vh;
      min-height: 620px;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 78% 8%, rgba(98,191,160,.055), transparent 25%),
        var(--bg);
    }

    /* ====================================================
       共用基金卡层：永远在白色主面板下面
       ==================================================== */
    .cards-stage {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 8;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .fund-card {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      border-radius: var(--fund-radius);
      border: 1px solid rgba(229,232,236,.94);
      background: #ffffff;
      overflow: hidden;
      isolation: isolate;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(32,38,44,.06);
      transform-origin: center;
      will-change: top, width, height, transform, opacity;
    }

    .fund-card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 210px;
      height: 210px;
      right: -76px;
      bottom: -132px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 18px solid rgba(98,191,160,.07);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 22px rgba(98,191,160,.043),
        0 0 0 45px rgba(98,191,160,.024);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .fund-card-inner {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
      height: 100%;
      padding: 16px 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: flex-start;
      will-change: opacity, transform;
    }

    .fund-card-top {
      position: relative;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .fund-name {
      min-width: 0;
      width: calc(100vw - 114px);
      max-width: none;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      font-size: 18px;
      line-height: 1.25;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -.2px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .fund-meta-line {
      display:none;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: 400;
      color: #9aa7b3;
      letter-spacing: .1px;
    }

    .auto-invest {
      position: absolute;
      right: 0;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: var(--calendar-blue);
    }

    .auto-invest svg {
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
    }

    .card-summary {
      margin-top: auto;
      align-self: flex-end;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-2);

      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(5px);
    }

    .card-summary .profit { color: var(--profit); }
    .card-summary .loss { color: var(--loss); }

      padding: 0 6px;

        element.classList.remove("positive", "negative", "neutral");

        if (String(value).trim().startsWith("-")) {
          element.classList.add("negative");
        } else if (String(value).trim().startsWith("+")) {

          amount:'—',cost:'—',shares:'—',avgNav:'—',autoInvest:'—',profit:'—',profitRate:'—',annualized:'—',realizedProfit:'—',cumulativeProfit:'—',nav:'—',navDelta:'—',navDate:'—',navStatus:'暂无详情'
        };

        l3Cost.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.cost);

        l3ProfitRate.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.profitRate);

        setSignedClass(l3ProfitRate, data.profitRate);
        setSignedClass(l3Annualized, data.annualized);

      }

      function level3HeroGeom() {
        return {
          top: 44,
          width: app.clientWidth - 24,
          height: 174,
          opacity: 1,
          scale: 1,
          x: 0,
          z: 8
        };
      }

      function easeOutBack(t, overshoot = .42) {
        const x = clamp(t);
        const c1 = overshoot;
        const c3 = c1 + 1;
        return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(x - 1, 2);
      }

      function easeInBack(t, overshoot = .36) {
        const x = clamp(t);
        const c1 = overshoot;
        const c3 = c1 + 1;
        return c3 * x * x * x - c1 * x * x;
      }

      function prepareDetailSheetCollapsed() {
        detailSheet.style.clipPath = "inset(0 0 100% 0)";
        detailSheet.style.transform = "translateY(-12px) scale(.994)";
        detailSheet.style.setProperty("--detail-seam-shadow", "0");
      }

      function renderDetailSheetEnter(progress) {
        const p = clamp(progress);
        const eased = easeOutBack(p);
        const hiddenBottom = (1 - p) * 100;

        detailSheet.style.clipPath =
          `inset(0 0 ${hiddenBottom}% 0)`;

        detailSheet.style.transform =
          `translateY(${lerp(-12, 0, eased)}px) scale(${lerp(.994,1,eased)})`;

        detailSheet.style.setProperty(
          "--detail-seam-shadow",
          String(smoothstep(clamp(p * 1.35)))
        );
      }

      function renderDetailSheetExit(progress) {
        const p = clamp(progress);
        const eased = easeInBack(p);
        const hiddenBottom = p * 100;

        detailSheet.style.clipPath =
          `inset(0 0 ${hiddenBottom}% 0)`;

        detailSheet.style.transform =
          `translateY(${lerp(0,-12,eased)}px) scale(${lerp(1,.994,eased)})`;

        detailSheet.style.setProperty(
          "--detail-seam-shadow",
          String(1 - smoothstep(clamp(p * 1.08)))
        );
      }

      function resetDetailSheet() {
        detailSheet.style.clipPath = "";
        detailSheet.style.transform = "";
        detailSheet.style.setProperty("--detail-seam-shadow", "1");
      }

      function animateLevel3Enter() {
        if (mode !== "level2") return;

        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const activeCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const activeSummary =
          activeCard.querySelector(".card-summary");

        const from =
          level2Geom(activeCard, currentIndex);
        const to =
          level3HeroGeom();

        const start =
          performance.now();

        // Phase 1: Hero
        // Phase 2: one complete Detail Sheet unfolds from under Hero
        const duration = 800;
        const HERO_PHASE_END = .27;

        mode = "transitioning";
        app.classList.add("level3-transition");
        level3Page.classList.add("is-visible");
        level3Page.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        level3Page.style.opacity = "1";
        level3Scroll.scrollTop = 0;

        populateLevel3(currentIndex);
        prepareDetailSheetCollapsed();
        level3Header.style.opacity = "0";
        level3Header.style.transform = "translateY(-4px)";

        level2Actions.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        stage.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        mainSheet.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        level3Page.style.pointerEvents = "auto";

        function frame(now) {
          const raw =
            clamp((now - start) / duration);

          const heroRaw =
            clamp((raw - .12) / (HERO_PHASE_END - .12));
          const heroEase =
            smoothstep(heroRaw);

          const heroTop =
            lerp(from.top, to.top, heroEase);
          const heroHeight =
            lerp(from.height, to.height, heroEase);

          level2Meta.style.opacity =
            String(1 - heroEase);

          level2Actions.style.opacity =
            String(1 - heroEase);

          mainSheet.style.opacity =
            String(1 - heroEase);

          // 返回 / 设置图标在 Hero 接近到位时再出现
          const headerFade =
            smoothstep(
              clamp((heroRaw - .35) / .65)
            );

          level3Header.style.opacity =
            String(headerFade);
          level3Header.style.transform =
            `translateY(${lerp(-4,0,headerFade)}px)`;

          if (activeSummary) {
            activeSummary.style.opacity=String(1-smoothstep(clamp(raw/.12)));
            activeSummary.style.transform='';
          }

          cards.forEach((card, index) => {
            if (card === activeCard) {
              if(raw<=.12){applyCardGeom(card,from);return;}
              applyHeroGeom(card, {
                top: heroTop,
                width:
                  lerp(from.width, to.width, heroEase),
                height:
                  heroHeight,
                opacity: 1,
                innerOpacity: 1,
                shellOpacity: 1,
                scale: 1,
                x: 0,
                z: 20
              }, to);
              return;
            }

            const base =
              level2Geom(card, currentIndex);

            const side =
              index < currentIndex ? -1 : 1;

            // 只有二级里本来可见的相邻卡参与淡出。
            // Far 卡（base.opacity === 0）始终保持隐藏，
            // 避免第一张/第三张作为中央卡时白色卡壳突然出现。
            const baseVisible =
              base.opacity > 0.005 ? 1 : 0;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...base,
              top:
                base.top +
                side * 26 * heroEase,
              scale:
                lerp(
                  base.scale,
                  base.scale * .975,
                  heroEase
                ),
              x:
                side * 6 * heroEase,
              shellOpacity:
                baseVisible * (1 - heroEase),
              innerOpacity:
                baseVisible ? base.opacity : 0,
              z: 1
            });
          });

          if (raw > HERO_PHASE_END) {
            const sheetRaw =
              clamp(
                (raw - HERO_PHASE_END) /
                (1 - HERO_PHASE_END)
              );

            renderDetailSheetEnter(
              easeOutCubic(sheetRaw)
            );
          }

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId =
              requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            mode = "level3";
            applyCardGeom(activeCard,to);
            level3Scroll.style.touchAction="pan-y";

            app.classList.remove(
              "level3-transition"
            );
            app.classList.add(
              "level3-mode"
            );

            resetDetailSheet();
            detailSheet.style.setProperty(
              "--detail-seam-shadow",
              "1"
            );
            level3Header.style.opacity = "1";
            level3Header.style.transform = "translateY(0)";

            if (activeSummary) {
              activeSummary.style.opacity = "0";
              activeSummary.style.transform =
                "translateY(5px)";
            }
          }
        }

        rafId =
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function animateLevel3Exit() {
        if (mode !== "level3") return;

        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const activeCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const activeSummary =
          activeCard.querySelector(".card-summary");

        const from =
          level3HeroGeom();
        const to =
          level2Geom(activeCard, currentIndex);

        const start =
          performance.now();

        /*
         * Overlapping exit:
         * - Detail Sheet starts folding first.
         * - At ~65% fold progress, Hero already begins to return.
         * - Other fund cards restore slightly after Hero starts.
         */
        const duration = 760;

        mode = "transitioning";

        app.classList.remove("level3-mode");
        app.classList.add("level3-transition");

        level3Page.style.pointerEvents = "none";

        function frame(now) {
          const raw =
            clamp((now - start) / duration);

          const sheetProgress =
            smoothstep(clamp(raw / .74));

          const heroStart = .48;
          const heroProgress =
            smoothstep(
              clamp((raw - heroStart) / (1 - heroStart))
            );

          const othersStart = .58;
          const othersProgress =
            smoothstep(
              clamp((raw - othersStart) / (1 - othersStart))
            );

          renderDetailSheetExit(sheetProgress);

          // Header fades early
          level3Header.style.opacity =
            String(
              1 - smoothstep(
                clamp(raw / .24)
              )
            );

          // Hero starts moving before sheet fully collapses
          applyHeroGeom(activeCard, {
            top:
              lerp(from.top, to.top, heroProgress),
            width:
              lerp(from.width, to.width, heroProgress),
            height:
              lerp(from.height, to.height, heroProgress),
            opacity: 1,
            innerOpacity: 1,
            shellOpacity: 1,
            scale: 1,
            x: 0,
            z: 20
          }, from);

          level2Meta.style.opacity =
            String(othersProgress);

          level2Actions.style.opacity =
            String(othersProgress);

          mainSheet.style.opacity =
            String(othersProgress);

          if (activeSummary) { activeSummary.style.opacity='0'; activeSummary.style.transform=''; }

          cards.forEach((card, index) => {
            if (card === activeCard) return;

            const base =
              level2Geom(card, currentIndex);

            const side =
              index < currentIndex ? -1 : 1;

            // 只恢复二级中本来可见的卡片。
            // Far 卡继续保持隐藏，防止退出三级时突然闪现。
            const baseVisible =
              base.opacity > 0.005 ? 1 : 0;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...base,
              top:
                base.top +
                side * 22 * (1 - othersProgress),
              scale:
                lerp(
                  base.scale * .978,
                  base.scale,
                  othersProgress
                ),
              x:
                side * 5 * (1 - othersProgress),
              shellOpacity:
                baseVisible * othersProgress,
              innerOpacity:
                baseVisible ? base.opacity : 0,
              z:
                base.z
            });
          });

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId =
              requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            mode = "level2";

            app.classList.remove(
              "level3-transition"
            );

            level3Page.classList.remove(
              "is-visible"
            );

            level3Page.setAttribute(
              "aria-hidden",
              "true"
            );

            level3Page.style.opacity = "";
            level3Page.style.pointerEvents = "";
            mainSheet.style.opacity = "";
            mainSheet.style.pointerEvents = "";

            resetDetailSheet();
            detailSheet.style.setProperty(
              "--detail-seam-shadow",
              "0"
            );

            level3Header.style.opacity = "";
            level3Header.style.transform = "";

            renderTransition(1);
            renderPagerSettled(currentIndex);
            if(activeSummary){activeSummary.style.opacity='1';activeSummary.style.transform='';if(!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)activeSummary.animate([{opacity:0},{opacity:1}],{duration:190,easing:'ease-out'});}

            level2Actions.style.pointerEvents =
              "auto";

            stage.style.pointerEvents =
              "auto";
          }
        }

        rafId =
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function showToast(text) {
        toast.textContent = text;
        toast.classList.add("show");
        clearTimeout(window.toastTimer);
        window.toastTimer = setTimeout(() => {
          toast.classList.remove("show");
        }, 1200);
      }

      /* 一级位置：
         上一张露在上面，当前卡前景，下一张完全藏在当前卡下方 */
      function level1Geom(card) {
        const selected = cards.indexOf(card) === currentIndex;
        return {
          top: 106,
          width: app.clientWidth - (selected ? 34 : 42),
          height: 104,
          opacity: selected ? 1 : 0,
          scale: selected ? 1 : .98,
          x: 0,
          z: selected ? 4 : 2
        };
      }

      function pagerSlotGeom(delta) {
        const h = 172;
        const width = app.clientWidth - 32;
        const bottomReserved = 96;
        const center = (app.clientHeight - bottomReserved) / 2;

        /*
         * 回到原来的纯纵向 Pager。
         *
         * 关键修正：
         * Current        opacity 1.00
         * Previous/Next  opacity 0.58
         * Far            opacity 0.00
         *
         * Previous/Next → Far 之间使用连续插值，
         * 所以卡片会从约 58% 一路慢慢淡到 0%，
         * 不再在某个阈值突然消失。
         */
        const anchors = {
          "-3": { y: -310, opacity: 0,    scale: .90,  z: 0 },
          "-2": { y: -232, opacity: 0,    scale: .92,  z: 1 },
          "-1": { y: -124, opacity: .58,  scale: .955, z: 3 },
           "0": { y:    0, opacity: 1,    scale: 1,    z: 5 },
           "1": { y:  124, opacity: .58,  scale: .955, z: 3 },
           "2": { y:  232, opacity: 0,    scale: .92,  z: 1 },
           "3": { y:  310, opacity: 0,    scale: .90,  z: 0 }
        };

        const bounded = clamp(delta, -3, 3);
        const low = Math.floor(bounded);
        const high = Math.ceil(bounded);

        const a = anchors[String(low)];
        const b = anchors[String(high)];
        const t = high === low ? 0 : bounded - low;

        return {
          top: center + lerp(a.y, b.y, t) - h / 2,
          width,
          height: h,
          opacity: lerp(a.opacity, b.opacity, t),
          scale: lerp(a.scale, b.scale, t),
          x: 0,
          z: Math.round(lerp(a.z, b.z, t))
        };
      }

      function level2Geom(card, virtualIndex = currentIndex) {
        const index = cards.indexOf(card);
        return pagerSlotGeom(index - virtualIndex);
      }

      function sheetTravelDistance() {
        // 一级顶部 156px -> 二级底部只露 46px 左右
        const sheetTop = 144;
        const targetTop = app.clientHeight - 47 - (window.innerHeight - document.documentElement.clientHeight);
        return Math.max(360, targetTop - sheetTop);
      }

      function renderTransition(p) {
        transitionProgress = clamp(p);

        // Read all geometry before any writes; a frame must not force layout per card.
        const geometry = cards.map(card => ({ card, a: level1Geom(card), b: level2Geom(card) }));
        const travel = sheetTravelDistance();
        geometry.forEach(({ card, a, b }) => {

          const top = lerp(a.top, b.top, transitionProgress);
          const width = lerp(a.width, b.width, transitionProgress);
          const height = lerp(a.height, b.height, transitionProgress);
          const scale = lerp(a.scale, b.scale, transitionProgress);
          let opacity;
          const index = cards.indexOf(card);

          if (index !== currentIndex) {
            // Neighboring cards emerge from behind the selected card in both directions.
            const delayed = clamp((transitionProgress - .18) / .82);
            opacity = lerp(a.opacity, b.opacity, delayed);
          } else {
            opacity = lerp(a.opacity, b.opacity, transitionProgress);
          }

          const sx = width / b.width, sy = height / b.height;
          if(card.style.top !== "0px") card.style.top = "0px";
          if(card.style.width !== `${b.width}px`) card.style.width = `${b.width}px`;
          if(card.style.height !== `${b.height}px`) card.style.height = `${b.height}px`;
          card.style.setProperty("--motion-sx", String(sx));
          card.style.setProperty("--motion-sy", String(sy));

          const neighbor = index !== currentIndex;
          const reveal = neighbor ? clamp((transitionProgress - .18) / .82) : 1;
          const visible = opacity > 0;
          card.style.opacity = visible ? String(reveal) : "0";
          card.inert = !visible;

          const inner = card.querySelector(".fund-card-inner");
          if (inner) {
            // Fade the whole card while keeping the original settled content opacity.
            inner.style.opacity = neighbor ? String(b.opacity) : String(opacity);
          }

          card.style.transform =
            `translate3d(-50%, ${top + (height - b.height) / 2}px, 0) scale(${sx * scale}, ${sy * scale})`;
          const cardTop = card.querySelector(".fund-card-top");
          cardTop.style.transformOrigin = "top left";
          cardTop.style.transform = `translate3d(${18 / sx - 18}px, ${16 / sy - 16}px,0) scale(${1 / sx},${1 / sy})`;
          card.style.zIndex = String(transitionProgress < .50 ? a.z : b.z);

          card.querySelector(".fund-meta-line").style.opacity = String(clamp((transitionProgress - .35) / .65));
          const name = card.querySelector(".fund-name");
          const indexIsCurrent = index === currentIndex;
          name.style.fontSize = `${lerp(indexIsCurrent ? 18 : 14, 18, transitionProgress)}px`;
          name.style.color = indexIsCurrent || transitionProgress > .82
            ? "#17212b"
            : `rgba(23,33,43,${lerp(.42,1,transitionProgress)})`;

          const summary = card.querySelector(".card-summary");
          const sp = clamp((transitionProgress - .42) / .58);
          summary.style.opacity = String(sp);
          summary.style.transformOrigin = "bottom right";
          summary.style.transform = `translate3d(${18 - 18 / sx}px,${16 - 16 / sy + lerp(5,0,sp) / sy}px,0) scale(${1 / sx},${1 / sy})`;
        });

        // 核心：同一块白色主面板只做位移，不做淡出
        const sheetY = travel * transitionProgress;
        mainSheet.style.transform = `translateY(${sheetY}px)`;

        // 内容随面板一起往下移；只有快离开屏幕时略淡，
        // 白色面板本身始终完整存在
        const contentFade = clamp((transitionProgress - .60) / .40);
        overviewContent.style.opacity = String(1 - contentFade);

        // 主底栏可以淡出，因为它不是白色主面板的一部分
        mainNav.style.opacity = String(1 - transitionProgress);
        mainNav.style.transform = `translate(-50%, ${lerp(0,90,transitionProgress)}px)`;

        const secondary = clamp((transitionProgress - .56) / .44);
        level2Meta.style.opacity = String(secondary);
        level2Actions.style.opacity = String(secondary);

        level2Actions.style.pointerEvents =
          secondary > .98 ? "auto" : "none";

        pagerCounter.textContent = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${cards.length}`;

        stage.style.pointerEvents =
          mode === "level2" && transitionProgress > .99 ? "auto" : "none";
      }

      // Freeze the hero's layout for each transition; animate its compositor transform.
      function applyHeroGeom(card,geom,layout) {
        card.style.top='0px';card.style.width=layout.width+'px';card.style.height=layout.height+'px';
        const sx=geom.width/layout.width,sy=geom.height/layout.height;
        card.style.transform='translate3d(-50%,'+geom.top+'px,0) scale('+sx+','+sy+')';
        card.style.opacity='1';card.style.zIndex='20';
        card.querySelector('.fund-card-top').style.transform='scale('+1/sx+','+1/sy+')';
        card.querySelector('.fund-card-top').style.transformOrigin='top left';
      }
      function applyCardGeom(card, geom) {
        card.querySelector(".fund-card-top").style.transform = "";
        const summary = card.querySelector(".card-summary");
        if (summary && mode === "level2") summary.style.transform = "translateY(0px)";
        const pager = mode === "level2";
        const top = pager ? "0px" : `${geom.top}px`;
        const width = `${geom.width}px`, height = `${geom.height}px`;
        if(card.style.top !== top) card.style.top = top;
        if(card.style.width !== width) card.style.width = width;
        if(card.style.height !== height) card.style.height = height;

        /*
         * 默认状态：
         * 白色卡片实体保持不透明，只淡化内部内容，避免后方文字透出。
         *
         * 离场状态：
         * 可传 shellOpacity，让整张卡随拖动真正淡到 0。
         * 这样不会再出现“白色实体一直存在，最后突然消失”的断点。
         */
        const shellOpacity =
          geom.shellOpacity !== undefined
            ? clamp(geom.shellOpacity)
            : (geom.opacity > 0.005 ? 1 : 0);

        const innerOpacity =
          geom.innerOpacity !== undefined
            ? clamp(geom.innerOpacity)
            : (geom.opacity > 0.005 ? geom.opacity : 0);

        card.style.opacity = String(shellOpacity);
        card.inert = shellOpacity <= .005;

        const inner = card.querySelector(".fund-card-inner");
        if (inner) {
          inner.style.opacity = String(innerOpacity);
        }

        const x = geom.x || 0;
        card.style.transform =
          pager ? `translate3d(calc(-50% + ${x}px), ${geom.top}px, 0) scale(${geom.scale})` :
          `translateX(calc(-50% + ${x}px)) scale(${geom.scale})`;
        card.style.zIndex = String(geom.z);
      }

      function renderPagerSettled(centerIndex = currentIndex) {
        cards.forEach(card => {
          applyCardGeom(card, level2Geom(card, centerIndex));
        });

        pagerCounter.textContent = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${cards.length}`;
        fitHandleHitArea();
      }

      /*
       * 二级滑动采用两阶段运动：
       *
       * 1. Reveal
       *    当前卡沿手指方向移开得更快；
       *    将出现卡只轻微跟随。
       *    两张 172px 高的卡最终拉开到约 190px 中心距，
       *    也就是完整露出后仍保留约 18px 空隙。
       *
       * 2. Catch-up
       *    将出现卡快速追向中央；
       *    原中央卡只补完剩余短距离。
       *
       * direction:
       *   +1 = 向上滑，下一张从下方成为中央卡
       *   -1 = 向下滑，上一张从上方成为中央卡
       */
      function renderPagerDrag(direction, travel) {
        const targetIndex = currentIndex + direction;

        if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= cards.length) {
          return;
        }

        const reveal = clamp(travel / PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE);
        const catchRaw = clamp(
          (travel - PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE) /
          (PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE - PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE)
        );
        const catchUp = smoothstep(catchRaw);
        const overall = smoothstep(clamp(travel / PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE));

        const currentCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const incomingCard = cards[targetIndex];

        // 与滑动方向相反一侧的相邻卡，就是本次离场卡。
        // 向上切下一张时，上方卡离场；
        // 向下切上一张时，下方卡离场。
        const outgoingIndex = currentIndex - direction;
        const outgoingCard =
          outgoingIndex >= 0 && outgoingIndex < cards.length
            ? cards[outgoingIndex]
            : null;

        /*
         * 本次切换后，新进入视野的边缘卡。
         * 它需要做离场卡的反向镜像渐显。
         */
        const enteringEdgeIndex = targetIndex + direction;

          const from = level2Geom(card, currentIndex);

             * 离场卡：
             * 淡化进度完全由手指拖动距离驱动。

             * 同时沿离场方向继续远离，并轻微向斜后方偏移。

              travel / PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE

              direction * 16 * fadeProgress;

              lerp(from.scale, .90, fadeProgress);

              1 - fadeProgress;

            // 再由整卡 shellOpacity 一起乘下去。
            const innerOpacity = from.opacity;

              ...from,
              top,
              x,
              scale,
              shellOpacity,
              innerOpacity,
              z: 2

          }

             * 进入卡：离场卡的反向镜像。
             * 拖动进度 0 → 1：
             * opacity 0 → 1
             * 从斜后方远端靠近目标相邻卡位

             */
            const enterProgress = clamp(
              travel / PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE
            );

            const top =
              finalGeom.top +
              direction * (110 * (1 - enterProgress));

            const x =
              -direction * 16 * (1 - enterProgress);

            const scale =
              lerp(.90, finalGeom.scale, enterProgress);

            const shellOpacity =
              enterProgress;

            const innerOpacity =
              finalGeom.opacity;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...finalGeom,
              top,
              x,
              scale,
              shellOpacity,
              innerOpacity,
              z: 2
            });

          }

            const top = catchRaw <= 0
              ? lerp(from.top, revealTop, reveal)

            const opacity = catchRaw <= 0
              ? from.opacity
              : lerp(1, to.opacity, catchUp);

            const scale = catchRaw <= 0
              ? from.scale
              : lerp(1, to.scale, catchUp);

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...from,
              top,
              x: 0,
              opacity,
              scale,
              z: catchUp < .46 ? 5 : 4
            });
            return;
          }

          if (card === incomingCard) {
            // 将出现卡：第一阶段只轻微跟手 22px，
            // 第二阶段再快速追到中央。
            const revealTop = from.top - direction * 22;
            const top = catchRaw <= 0
              ? lerp(from.top, revealTop, reveal)
              : lerp(revealTop, to.top, catchUp);

            const revealOpacity = lerp(from.opacity, .76, reveal);
            const opacity = catchRaw <= 0
              ? revealOpacity
              : lerp(.76, 1, catchUp);

            const revealScale = lerp(from.scale, .97, reveal);
            const scale = catchRaw <= 0
              ? revealScale
              : lerp(.97, 1, catchUp);

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...from,
              top,
              x: 0,
              opacity,
              scale,
              z: catchUp < .46 ? 4 : 6
            });
            return;
          }

          // 非参与卡仅平滑让位，不抢视觉焦点
          applyCardGeom(card, {
            top: lerp(from.top, to.top, overall),
            width: lerp(from.width, to.width, overall),
            height: lerp(from.height, to.height, overall),
            opacity: lerp(from.opacity, to.opacity, overall),
            scale: lerp(from.scale, to.scale, overall),
            x: 0,
            z: overall < .5 ? from.z : to.z

      function renderPagerBoundary(offset) {

      function animatePagerTravel(direction, fromTravel, toTravel, duration, commit) {

          } else {

            rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            done?.();
          }

        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function settleLevel1() {
        mode = "level1";
        sheetHandleZone.style.setProperty("--handle-extra","0px");
        renderTransition(0);
      }

      function fitHandleHitArea(){
        if(mode!=='level2')return;const handleTop=sheetHandleZone.getBoundingClientRect().top;

      let lowerDrag=null;

      stage.addEventListener("click",event=>{const card=event.target.closest(".fund-card");if(mode==="level2"&&card===cards[currentIndex]&&!pagerMoved&&!app.classList.contains("sort-mode"))animateLevel3Enter();});

        if (mode !== "level2" || app.classList.contains("sort-mode")) return;

        pagerPointer = event.pointerId;
        pagerDragTravel = 0;
        pagerDragDirection = 0;
        pagerMoved = false;

          pagerMoved = false;

            tappedCard &&
            tappedCard === cards[currentIndex] &&
            !app.classList.contains("sort-mode")

        const targetIndex = currentIndex + direction;

          pagerDragTravel + Math.abs(pagerVelocityY) * 92;

          Math.abs(pagerVelocityY) >= .52 &&
          Math.sign(-pagerVelocityY) === direction;

          projectedTravel >= PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE * .78 ||
          velocityCommits;

            direction,
            pagerDragTravel,
            PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE,
            PAGER_SETTLE_MS,
            true

            direction,
            pagerDragTravel,
            0,
            240,
            false
          );
        }
      });

        if (mode !== "level2") return;

        pagerStartY = null;
        pagerPointer = null;
        pagerTapCard = null;

          animatePagerTravel(
            pagerDragDirection,
            pagerDragTravel,
            0,
            220,
            false
          );
        } else {
          renderPagerSettled(currentIndex);
          pagerMoved = false;
        }
      });

          mode !== "level2" ||
          app.classList.contains("sort-mode") ||
          wheelLocked

        pagerMoved = true;

          direction,
          0,
          PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE,
          PAGER_SETTLE_MS,
          true

         二级添加 / 排序
         ====================== */

      level3Back.addEventListener("click", () => {

      level3Settings.addEventListener("click", () => parent.V2App.detailSettings(cards[currentIndex]?.dataset.fundId));


      sortButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (mode !== "level2") return;
        app.classList.add("sort-mode");
      });

      function syncFundOrderFromSort() {
        const activeCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const oldCards = [...cards];
        const oldDetails = [...detailModels];

        const orderedIds =
          sortCards().map(sortCard => sortCard.dataset.fundId);

        const reorderedCards = orderedIds
          .map(id =>
            oldCards.find(card => card.dataset.fundId === id)
          )
          .filter(Boolean);

        oldCards.forEach(card => {
          if (!reorderedCards.includes(card)) {
            reorderedCards.push(card);
          }
        });

          .map(card =>
            oldDetails.find(
              item => item.id === card.dataset.fundId
            )
          )
          .filter(Boolean);

         排序：右侧把手跟手拖动 + FLIP 挤压换位

      let sortDrag = null;

      function sortCards() {
        return [...sortOverlay.querySelectorAll(".sort-card")];
      }

      function stopSortAutoScroll() {
        if (sortAutoScrollRaf) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(sortAutoScrollRaf);

        }
      }

        stopSortAutoScroll();

        const rect = sortOverlay.getBoundingClientRect();
        const edge = 54;
        let speed = 0;

        if (pointerY < rect.top + edge) {
          speed = -Math.min(9, (rect.top + edge - pointerY) * .16);
        } else if (pointerY > rect.bottom - edge) {
          speed = Math.min(9, (pointerY - (rect.bottom - edge)) * .16);

          sortOverlay.scrollTop += speed;

          card,
          handle,
          pointerId: event.pointerId,
          startY: event.clientY,
          lastY: event.clientY,

         * 所以跨过中线后，卡片不会突然跳到新布局位置，

       ==================================================== */
    .level2-meta {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 15;
      top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 15px);
      left: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      color: var(--text-3);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* 添加丨排序独立浮在浅灰背景上 */
    .level2-actions {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 16;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: calc(54px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
      min-height: 34px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 7px;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      will-change: opacity;
    }

    .compact-action {
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 30px;
      border: 0;
      padding: 0 5px;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-3);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: 8px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .compact-action:active {
      background: var(--surface-soft);
      transform: scale(.98);
    }

    .compact-divider {
      color: var(--disabled);
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .sort-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 28;
      inset: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px) 16px 84px;
      display: none;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: var(--bg);
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }

    .sort-overlay::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .app.sort-mode .sort-overlay { display: block; }
    .app.sort-mode .cards-stage,
    .app.sort-mode .level2-meta { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
    .app.sort-mode .level2-actions { display: none; }

    .sort-card {
      min-height: 92px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      padding: 16px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 44px;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--divider);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(23,33,43,.04);
    }

    .sort-name {
      min-width: 0;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .sort-handle {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      color: var(--text-3);
      border-radius: 12px;
      cursor: grab;
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .sort-handle:active { background: var(--surface-soft); }

    .sort-done {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 35;
      left: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      bottom: calc(7px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
      display: none;
    }

    .app.sort-mode .sort-done { display: block; }

    .done-button {
      width: 100%;
      height: 44px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--brand-soft);
      color: var(--brand);
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .toast {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 50;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: calc(100px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
      transform: translate(-50%,10px);
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(23,33,43,.9);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 12px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: 180ms ease;
    }

    .toast.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translate(-50%,0);
    }

    @media (min-width: 431px) {
      body { padding: 22px 0; }

      .app {
        height: calc(100vh - 44px);
        border-radius: 28px;
        box-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(18,21,26,.12);
      }
    }
  
    /* ===== 排序模式：右侧把手跟手拖动 ===== */
    .sort-overlay {
      touch-action: pan-y;
    }

    .sort-card {
      position: relative;
      transition:
        box-shadow 180ms ease,
        opacity 180ms ease;
      will-change: transform;
    }

    .sort-card.is-dragging {
      z-index: 40;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(23,33,43,.12);
      transition:
        box-shadow 120ms ease,
        opacity 120ms ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .sort-card.is-shifting {
      transition:
        transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.18,.82,.22,1);
    }

    .sort-handle {
      touch-action: none;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    .sort-handle:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

  
    /* ====================================================
       持仓三级详情
       - 基于冻结的 Level 1 / Level 2 继续扩展
       - Shared Card Transition 使用二级中央卡本体
       ==================================================== */
    .level3-page {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 12;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 5%, rgba(98,191,160,.045), transparent 24%),
        var(--bg);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
      will-change: opacity;
    }

    .level3-page.is-visible {
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .app.level3-transition .cards-stage,
    .app.level3-mode .cards-stage {
      z-index: 26;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .level3-header {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 30;
      top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 1px);
      left: 8px;
      right: 8px;
      height: 40px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      pointer-events: none;
      will-change: opacity;
    }

    .level3-icon-button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--text-2);
      pointer-events: auto;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .level3-icon-button:active {
      transform: scale(.94);
      background: transparent;
    }

    .level3-icon-button svg {
      width: 17px;
      height: 17px;
      display: block;
    }

    .app.level3-mode .main-sheet,.app.level3-transition .main-sheet{pointer-events:none}
    .level3-scroll {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 205px);
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
      overflow-y: auto;
      touch-action: pan-y;
      overscroll-behavior-y: contain;
      padding: 0 18px 24px;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    .level3-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .detail-sheet {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin-top: -28px;
      padding-top: 28px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0 0 22px 22px;
      box-shadow:
        0 18px 34px -14px rgba(28,31,36,.12);
      transform-origin: center top;
      will-change: transform, clip-path;
    }

    .detail-sheet::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 30;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      top: 0;
      height: 16px;
      background: var(--surface);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .detail-sheet::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 29;
      left: 2px;
      right: 2px;
      top: 5px;
      height: 36px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          to bottom,
          rgba(23,33,43,.34),
          rgba(23,33,43,.20) 34%,
          rgba(23,33,43,.075) 66%,
          rgba(23,33,43,0) 100%
        );
      filter: blur(2px);
      opacity: var(--detail-seam-shadow, 0);
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 120ms linear;
    }

    .detail-section {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 18px 16px;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
      box-shadow: none;
    }

    .detail-section + .detail-section {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--divider);
    }

    .detail-sheet > .detail-section:first-child {
      border-top: 0;
    }

    .detail-section-title {
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text-3);
      letter-spacing: .02em;
    }

    .detail-primary {
      padding-bottom: 15px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
    }

    .detail-primary-label {
      margin-bottom: 7px;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      color: var(--text-3);
    }

    .detail-primary-value {
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: 650;
      letter-spacing: -.45px;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }

    .detail-primary-value.positive {
      color: var(--profit);
    }

    .detail-primary-value.negative {
      color: var(--loss);
    }

    .detail-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
      gap: 15px 18px;
    }

    .detail-item {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .detail-item-label {
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--text-3);
    }

    .detail-item-value {
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.25;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--text);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }

    .detail-item-value.positive { color: var(--profit); }
    .detail-item-value.negative { color: var(--loss); }

    .nav-value-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 9px;
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .nav-delta {
      font-size: 11.5px;
      line-height: 1;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .nav-delta.positive { color: var(--profit); }
    .nav-delta.negative { color: var(--loss); }

    .detail-status {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 24px;
      padding: 0 9px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--brand-soft);
      color: #3d8f72;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    (() => {
      const app = document.getElementById("app");
      const stage = document.getElementById("cardsStage");
      let cards = [...document.querySelectorAll(".fund-card")];

      const mainSheet = document.getElementById("mainSheet");
      const sheetHandleZone = document.getElementById("sheetHandleZone");
      const overviewContent = document.getElementById("overviewContent");
      const mainNav = document.getElementById("mainNav");

      const level2Meta = document.getElementById("level2Meta");

      const level2Actions = document.getElementById("level2Actions");

      const addButton = document.getElementById("addButton");

      const sortOverlay = document.getElementById("sortOverlay");

      const level3Page = document.getElementById("level3Page");

      const l3AutoInvest = document.getElementById("l3AutoInvest");
      const l3Profit = document.getElementById("l3Profit");
      const l3ProfitRate = document.getElementById("l3ProfitRate");
      const l3Annualized = document.getElementById("l3Annualized");
      const l3RealizedProfit = document.getElementById("l3RealizedProfit");
      const l3CumulativeProfit = document.getElementById("l3CumulativeProfit");
      const l3Nav = document.getElementById("l3Nav");
      const l3NavDelta = document.getElementById("l3NavDelta");
      const l3NavDate = document.getElementById("l3NavDate");
      const l3NavStatus = document.getElementById("l3NavStatus");


      const DRAG_DISTANCE = 320;
      const ENTER_THRESHOLD = 0.28;

      let mode = "level1"; // level1 / transitioning / level2 / level3
      let transitionProgress = 0;

      // DOM: easy(0), guangfa(1), huaxia(2)
      let currentIndex = 1;

      let sheetDragStartY = null;
      let sheetPointer = null;

      const PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE = 96;
      const PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE = 156;
      const PAGER_SETTLE_MS = 300;

      let pagerStartY = null;
      let pagerPointer = null;
      let pagerDragTravel = 0;
      let pagerDragDirection = 0;
      let pagerMoved = false;
      let pagerVelocityY = 0;
      let pagerLastY = 0;
      let pagerLastT = 0;
      let pagerTapCard = null;
      let wheelLocked = false;

      let rafId = 0;

      function clamp(v, a = 0, b = 1) {
        return Math.max(a, Math.min(b, v));
      }

      function lerp(a, b, t) {
        return a + (b - a) * t;
      }

      function easeOutCubic(t) {
        return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      }

      function smoothstep(t) {
        const x = clamp(t);
        return x * x * (3 - 2 * x);
      }

      let detailModels = [];

      // Read-only lookup of the supplied FundDetailUiModel.
      const detailLookup = {
        getById(fundId) {
          return detailModels.find(item => item.id === fundId);
        }
      };

      function setSignedClass(element, value) {
        element.classList.remove("positive", "negative", "neutral");

        if (String(value).trim().startsWith("-")) {
          element.classList.add("negative");
        } else if (String(value).trim().startsWith("+")) {
          element.classList.add("positive");
        } else {
          element.classList.add("neutral");
        }
      }

      function populateLevel3(index) {
        const fundId = cards[index].dataset.fundId;
        const data = detailLookup.getById(fundId) || {
          amount:'—',cost:'—',shares:'—',avgNav:'—',autoInvest:'—',profit:'—',profitRate:'—',annualized:'—',realizedProfit:'—',cumulativeProfit:'—',nav:'—',navDelta:'—',navDate:'—',navStatus:'暂无详情'
        };

        l3Amount.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.amount);
        l3Cost.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.cost);
        l3Shares.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.shares);
        l3AvgNav.textContent = data.avgNav;
        l3AutoInvest.textContent = data.autoInvest;

        l3Profit.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.profit);
        l3ProfitRate.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.profitRate);
        l3Annualized.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.annualized);
        l3RealizedProfit.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.realizedProfit);
        l3CumulativeProfit.textContent = parent.V2Display(data.cumulativeProfit);

        setSignedClass(l3Profit, data.profit);
        setSignedClass(l3ProfitRate, data.profitRate);
        setSignedClass(l3Annualized, data.annualized);
        setSignedClass(l3RealizedProfit, data.realizedProfit);
        setSignedClass(l3CumulativeProfit, data.cumulativeProfit);

        l3Nav.textContent = data.nav;
        l3NavDelta.textContent = data.navDelta;
        setSignedClass(l3NavDelta, data.navDelta);

        const holdingTime=parent.v2HoldingTime(fundId,parent.V2Store.getState());
        document.getElementById('l3HoldingStart').textContent=holdingTime.date;
        document.getElementById('l3HoldingDays').textContent=holdingTime.days;
        l3NavDate.textContent = data.navDate;
        l3NavStatus.textContent = data.navStatus;
      }

      function level3HeroGeom() {
        return {
          top: 44,
          width: app.clientWidth - 24,
          height: 174,
          opacity: 1,
          scale: 1,
          x: 0,
          z: 8
        };
      }

      function easeOutBack(t, overshoot = .42) {
        const x = clamp(t);
        const c1 = overshoot;
        const c3 = c1 + 1;
        return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(x - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(x - 1, 2);
      }

      function easeInBack(t, overshoot = .36) {
        const x = clamp(t);
        const c1 = overshoot;
        const c3 = c1 + 1;
        return c3 * x * x * x - c1 * x * x;
      }

      function prepareDetailSheetCollapsed() {
        detailSheet.style.clipPath = "inset(0 0 100% 0)";
        detailSheet.style.transform = "translateY(-12px) scale(.994)";
        detailSheet.style.setProperty("--detail-seam-shadow", "0");
      }

      function renderDetailSheetEnter(progress) {
        const p = clamp(progress);
        const eased = easeOutBack(p);
        const hiddenBottom = (1 - p) * 100;

        detailSheet.style.clipPath =
          `inset(0 0 ${hiddenBottom}% 0)`;

        detailSheet.style.transform =
          `translateY(${lerp(-12, 0, eased)}px) scale(${lerp(.994,1,eased)})`;

        detailSheet.style.setProperty(
          "--detail-seam-shadow",
          String(smoothstep(clamp(p * 1.35)))
        );
      }

      function renderDetailSheetExit(progress) {
        const p = clamp(progress);
        const eased = easeInBack(p);
        const hiddenBottom = p * 100;

        detailSheet.style.clipPath =
          `inset(0 0 ${hiddenBottom}% 0)`;

        detailSheet.style.transform =
          `translateY(${lerp(0,-12,eased)}px) scale(${lerp(1,.994,eased)})`;

        detailSheet.style.setProperty(
          "--detail-seam-shadow",
          String(1 - smoothstep(clamp(p * 1.08)))
        );
      }

      function resetDetailSheet() {
        detailSheet.style.clipPath = "";
        detailSheet.style.transform = "";
        detailSheet.style.setProperty("--detail-seam-shadow", "1");
      }

      function animateLevel3Enter() {
        if (mode !== "level2") return;

        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const activeCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const activeSummary =
          activeCard.querySelector(".card-summary");

        const from =
          level2Geom(activeCard, currentIndex);
        const to =
          level3HeroGeom();

        const start =
          performance.now();

        // Phase 1: Hero
        // Phase 2: one complete Detail Sheet unfolds from under Hero
        const duration = 800;
        const HERO_PHASE_END = .27;

        mode = "transitioning";
        app.classList.add("level3-transition");
        level3Page.classList.add("is-visible");
        level3Page.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        level3Page.style.opacity = "1";
        level3Scroll.scrollTop = 0;

        populateLevel3(currentIndex);
        prepareDetailSheetCollapsed();
        level3Header.style.opacity = "0";
        level3Header.style.transform = "translateY(-4px)";

        level2Actions.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        stage.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        mainSheet.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        level3Page.style.pointerEvents = "auto";

        function frame(now) {
          const raw =
            clamp((now - start) / duration);

          const heroRaw =
            clamp((raw - .12) / (HERO_PHASE_END - .12));
          const heroEase =
            smoothstep(heroRaw);

          const heroTop =
            lerp(from.top, to.top, heroEase);
          const heroHeight =
            lerp(from.height, to.height, heroEase);

          level2Meta.style.opacity =
            String(1 - heroEase);

          level2Actions.style.opacity =
            String(1 - heroEase);

          mainSheet.style.opacity =
            String(1 - heroEase);

          // 返回 / 设置图标在 Hero 接近到位时再出现
          const headerFade =
            smoothstep(
              clamp((heroRaw - .35) / .65)
            );

          level3Header.style.opacity =
            String(headerFade);
          level3Header.style.transform =
            `translateY(${lerp(-4,0,headerFade)}px)`;

          if (activeSummary) {
            activeSummary.style.opacity=String(1-smoothstep(clamp(raw/.12)));
            activeSummary.style.transform='';
          }

          cards.forEach((card, index) => {
            if (card === activeCard) {
              if(raw<=.12){applyCardGeom(card,from);return;}
              applyHeroGeom(card, {
                top: heroTop,
                width:
                  lerp(from.width, to.width, heroEase),
                height:
                  heroHeight,
                opacity: 1,
                innerOpacity: 1,
                shellOpacity: 1,
                scale: 1,
                x: 0,
                z: 20
              }, to);
              return;
            }

            const base =
              level2Geom(card, currentIndex);

            const side =
              index < currentIndex ? -1 : 1;

            // Far 卡（base.opacity === 0）始终保持隐藏，
            // 避免第一张/第三张作为中央卡时白色卡壳突然出现。
            const baseVisible =
              base.opacity > 0.005 ? 1 : 0;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...base,
              top:
                base.top +
                side * 26 * heroEase,
              scale:
                lerp(
                  base.scale,
                  base.scale * .975,
                  heroEase
                ),
              x:
                side * 6 * heroEase,
              shellOpacity:
                baseVisible * (1 - heroEase),
              innerOpacity:
                baseVisible ? base.opacity : 0,
              z: 1
            });
          });

          if (raw > HERO_PHASE_END) {
            const sheetRaw =
              clamp(
                (raw - HERO_PHASE_END) /
                (1 - HERO_PHASE_END)
              );

            renderDetailSheetEnter(
              easeOutCubic(sheetRaw)
            );
          }

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId =
              requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            mode = "level3";
            applyCardGeom(activeCard,to);
            level3Scroll.style.touchAction="pan-y";

            app.classList.remove(
              "level3-transition"
            );
            app.classList.add(
              "level3-mode"
            );

            resetDetailSheet();
            detailSheet.style.setProperty(
              "--detail-seam-shadow",
              "1"
            );
            level3Header.style.opacity = "1";
            level3Header.style.transform = "translateY(0)";

            if (activeSummary) {
              activeSummary.style.opacity = "0";
              activeSummary.style.transform =
                "translateY(5px)";
            }
          }
        }

        rafId =
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function animateLevel3Exit() {
        if (mode !== "level3") return;

        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const activeCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const activeSummary =
          activeCard.querySelector(".card-summary");

        const from =
          level3HeroGeom();
        const to =
          level2Geom(activeCard, currentIndex);

        const start =
          performance.now();

        /*
         * Overlapping exit:
         * - Detail Sheet starts folding first.
         * - At ~65% fold progress, Hero already begins to return.
         * - Other fund cards restore slightly after Hero starts.
         */
        const duration = 760;

        mode = "transitioning";

        app.classList.remove("level3-mode");
        app.classList.add("level3-transition");

        level3Page.style.pointerEvents = "none";

        function frame(now) {
          const raw =
            clamp((now - start) / duration);

          const sheetProgress =
            smoothstep(clamp(raw / .74));

          const heroStart = .48;
          const heroProgress =
            smoothstep(
              clamp((raw - heroStart) / (1 - heroStart))
            );

          const othersStart = .58;
          const othersProgress =
            smoothstep(
              clamp((raw - othersStart) / (1 - othersStart))
            );

          renderDetailSheetExit(sheetProgress);

          // Header fades early
          level3Header.style.opacity =
            String(
              1 - smoothstep(
                clamp(raw / .24)
              )
            );

          // Hero starts moving before sheet fully collapses
          applyHeroGeom(activeCard, {
            top:
              lerp(from.top, to.top, heroProgress),
            width:
              lerp(from.width, to.width, heroProgress),
            height:
              lerp(from.height, to.height, heroProgress),
            opacity: 1,
            innerOpacity: 1,
            shellOpacity: 1,
            scale: 1,
            x: 0,
            z: 20
          }, from);

          level2Meta.style.opacity =
            String(othersProgress);

          level2Actions.style.opacity =
            String(othersProgress);

          mainSheet.style.opacity =
            String(othersProgress);

          if (activeSummary) { activeSummary.style.opacity='0'; activeSummary.style.transform=''; }

          cards.forEach((card, index) => {
            if (card === activeCard) return;

            const base =
              level2Geom(card, currentIndex);

            const side =
              index < currentIndex ? -1 : 1;

            // 只恢复二级中本来可见的卡片。
            // Far 卡继续保持隐藏，防止退出三级时突然闪现。
            const baseVisible =
              base.opacity > 0.005 ? 1 : 0;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...base,
              top:
                base.top +
                side * 22 * (1 - othersProgress),
              scale:
                lerp(
                  base.scale * .978,
                  base.scale,
                  othersProgress
                ),
              x:
                side * 5 * (1 - othersProgress),
              shellOpacity:
                baseVisible * othersProgress,
              innerOpacity:
                baseVisible ? base.opacity : 0,
              z:
                base.z
            });
          });

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId =
              requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            mode = "level2";

            app.classList.remove(
              "level3-transition"
            );

            level3Page.classList.remove(
              "is-visible"
            );

            level3Page.setAttribute(
              "aria-hidden",
              "true"
            );

            level3Page.style.opacity = "";
            level3Page.style.pointerEvents = "";
            mainSheet.style.opacity = "";
            mainSheet.style.pointerEvents = "";

            resetDetailSheet();
            detailSheet.style.setProperty(
              "--detail-seam-shadow",
              "0"
            );

            level3Header.style.opacity = "";
            level3Header.style.transform = "";

            renderTransition(1);
            renderPagerSettled(currentIndex);
            if(activeSummary){activeSummary.style.opacity='1';activeSummary.style.transform='';if(!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)activeSummary.animate([{opacity:0},{opacity:1}],{duration:190,easing:'ease-out'});}

            level2Actions.style.pointerEvents =
              "auto";

            stage.style.pointerEvents =
              "auto";
          }
        }

        rafId =
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      /* 一级位置：
         上一张露在上面，当前卡前景，下一张完全藏在当前卡下方 */
      function level1Geom(card) {
        const selected = cards.indexOf(card) === currentIndex;
        return {
          top: 106,
          width: app.clientWidth - (selected ? 34 : 42),
          height: 104,
          opacity: selected ? 1 : 0,
          scale: selected ? 1 : .98,
          x: 0,
          z: selected ? 4 : 2
        };
      }

      function pagerSlotGeom(delta) {
        const h = 172;
        const width = app.clientWidth - 32;
        const bottomReserved = 96;
        const center = (app.clientHeight - bottomReserved) / 2;

        /*
         * 回到原来的纯纵向 Pager。
         *
         * 关键修正：
         * Current        opacity 1.00
         * Previous/Next  opacity 0.58
         * Far            opacity 0.00
         *
         * Previous/Next → Far 之间使用连续插值，
         * 所以卡片会从约 58% 一路慢慢淡到 0%，
         * 不再在某个阈值突然消失。
         */
        const anchors = {
          "-3": { y: -310, opacity: 0,    scale: .90,  z: 0 },
          "-2": { y: -232, opacity: 0,    scale: .92,  z: 1 },
          "-1": { y: -124, opacity: .58,  scale: .955, z: 3 },
           "0": { y:    0, opacity: 1,    scale: 1,    z: 5 },
           "1": { y:  124, opacity: .58,  scale: .955, z: 3 },
           "2": { y:  232, opacity: 0,    scale: .92,  z: 1 },
           "3": { y:  310, opacity: 0,    scale: .90,  z: 0 }
        };

        const bounded = clamp(delta, -3, 3);
        const low = Math.floor(bounded);
        const high = Math.ceil(bounded);

        const a = anchors[String(low)];
        const b = anchors[String(high)];
        const t = high === low ? 0 : bounded - low;

        return {
          top: center + lerp(a.y, b.y, t) - h / 2,
          width,
          height: h,
          opacity: lerp(a.opacity, b.opacity, t),
          scale: lerp(a.scale, b.scale, t),
          x: 0,
          z: Math.round(lerp(a.z, b.z, t))
        };
      }

      function level2Geom(card, virtualIndex = currentIndex) {
        const index = cards.indexOf(card);
        return pagerSlotGeom(index - virtualIndex);
      }

      function sheetTravelDistance() {
        // 一级顶部 156px -> 二级底部只露 46px 左右
        const sheetTop = 144;
        const targetTop = app.clientHeight - 47 - (window.innerHeight - document.documentElement.clientHeight);
        return Math.max(360, targetTop - sheetTop);
      }

      function renderTransition(p) {
        transitionProgress = clamp(p);

        // Read all geometry before any writes; a frame must not force layout per card.
        const geometry = cards.map(card => ({ card, a: level1Geom(card), b: level2Geom(card) }));
        const travel = sheetTravelDistance();
        geometry.forEach(({ card, a, b }) => {

          const top = lerp(a.top, b.top, transitionProgress);
          const width = lerp(a.width, b.width, transitionProgress);
          const height = lerp(a.height, b.height, transitionProgress);
          const scale = lerp(a.scale, b.scale, transitionProgress);
          let opacity;
          const index = cards.indexOf(card);

          if (index !== currentIndex) {
            // Neighboring cards emerge from behind the selected card in both directions.
            const delayed = clamp((transitionProgress - .18) / .82);
            opacity = lerp(a.opacity, b.opacity, delayed);
          } else {
            opacity = lerp(a.opacity, b.opacity, transitionProgress);
          }

          const sx = width / b.width, sy = height / b.height;
          if(card.style.top !== "0px") card.style.top = "0px";
          if(card.style.width !== `${b.width}px`) card.style.width = `${b.width}px`;
          if(card.style.height !== `${b.height}px`) card.style.height = `${b.height}px`;
          card.style.setProperty("--motion-sx", String(sx));
          card.style.setProperty("--motion-sy", String(sy));

          const neighbor = index !== currentIndex;
          const reveal = neighbor ? clamp((transitionProgress - .18) / .82) : 1;
          const visible = opacity > 0;
          card.style.opacity = visible ? String(reveal) : "0";
          card.inert = !visible;

          const inner = card.querySelector(".fund-card-inner");
          if (inner) {
            // Fade the whole card while keeping the original settled content opacity.
            inner.style.opacity = neighbor ? String(b.opacity) : String(opacity);
          }

          card.style.transform =
            `translate3d(-50%, ${top + (height - b.height) / 2}px, 0) scale(${sx * scale}, ${sy * scale})`;
          const cardTop = card.querySelector(".fund-card-top");
          cardTop.style.transformOrigin = "top left";
          cardTop.style.transform = `translate3d(${18 / sx - 18}px, ${16 / sy - 16}px,0) scale(${1 / sx},${1 / sy})`;
          card.style.zIndex = String(transitionProgress < .50 ? a.z : b.z);

          card.querySelector(".fund-meta-line").style.opacity = String(clamp((transitionProgress - .35) / .65));
          const name = card.querySelector(".fund-name");
          const indexIsCurrent = index === currentIndex;
          name.style.fontSize = `${lerp(indexIsCurrent ? 18 : 14, 18, transitionProgress)}px`;
          name.style.color = indexIsCurrent || transitionProgress > .82
            ? "#17212b"
            : `rgba(23,33,43,${lerp(.42,1,transitionProgress)})`;

          const summary = card.querySelector(".card-summary");
          const sp = clamp((transitionProgress - .42) / .58);
          summary.style.opacity = String(sp);
          summary.style.transformOrigin = "bottom right";
          summary.style.transform = `translate3d(${18 - 18 / sx}px,${16 - 16 / sy + lerp(5,0,sp) / sy}px,0) scale(${1 / sx},${1 / sy})`;
        });

        // 核心：同一块白色主面板只做位移，不做淡出
        const sheetY = travel * transitionProgress;
        mainSheet.style.transform = `translateY(${sheetY}px)`;

        // 内容随面板一起往下移；只有快离开屏幕时略淡，
        // 白色面板本身始终完整存在
        const contentFade = clamp((transitionProgress - .60) / .40);
        overviewContent.style.opacity = String(1 - contentFade);

        // 主底栏可以淡出，因为它不是白色主面板的一部分
        mainNav.style.opacity = String(1 - transitionProgress);
        mainNav.style.transform = `translate(-50%, ${lerp(0,90,transitionProgress)}px)`;

        const secondary = clamp((transitionProgress - .56) / .44);
        level2Meta.style.opacity = String(secondary);
        level2Actions.style.opacity = String(secondary);

        level2Actions.style.pointerEvents =
          secondary > .98 ? "auto" : "none";

        pagerCounter.textContent = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${cards.length}`;

        stage.style.pointerEvents =
          mode === "level2" && transitionProgress > .99 ? "auto" : "none";
      }

      // Freeze the hero's layout for each transition; animate its compositor transform.
      function applyHeroGeom(card,geom,layout) {
        card.style.top='0px';card.style.width=layout.width+'px';card.style.height=layout.height+'px';
        const sx=geom.width/layout.width,sy=geom.height/layout.height;
        card.style.transform='translate3d(-50%,'+geom.top+'px,0) scale('+sx+','+sy+')';
        card.style.opacity='1';card.style.zIndex='20';
        card.querySelector('.fund-card-top').style.transform='scale('+1/sx+','+1/sy+')';
        card.querySelector('.fund-card-top').style.transformOrigin='top left';
      }
      function applyCardGeom(card, geom) {
        card.querySelector(".fund-card-top").style.transform = "";
        const summary = card.querySelector(".card-summary");
        if (summary && mode === "level2") summary.style.transform = "translateY(0px)";
        const pager = mode === "level2";
        const top = pager ? "0px" : `${geom.top}px`;
        const width = `${geom.width}px`, height = `${geom.height}px`;
        if(card.style.top !== top) card.style.top = top;
        if(card.style.width !== width) card.style.width = width;
        if(card.style.height !== height) card.style.height = height;

        /*
         * 默认状态：
         * 白色卡片实体保持不透明，只淡化内部内容，避免后方文字透出。
         *
         * 离场状态：
         * 可传 shellOpacity，让整张卡随拖动真正淡到 0。
         * 这样不会再出现“白色实体一直存在，最后突然消失”的断点。
         */
        const shellOpacity =
          geom.shellOpacity !== undefined
            ? clamp(geom.shellOpacity)
            : (geom.opacity > 0.005 ? 1 : 0);

        const innerOpacity =
          geom.innerOpacity !== undefined
            ? clamp(geom.innerOpacity)
            : (geom.opacity > 0.005 ? geom.opacity : 0);

        card.style.opacity = String(shellOpacity);
        card.inert = shellOpacity <= .005;

        const inner = card.querySelector(".fund-card-inner");
        if (inner) {
          inner.style.opacity = String(innerOpacity);
        }

        const x = geom.x || 0;
        card.style.transform =
          pager ? `translate3d(calc(-50% + ${x}px), ${geom.top}px, 0) scale(${geom.scale})` :
          `translateX(calc(-50% + ${x}px)) scale(${geom.scale})`;
        card.style.zIndex = String(geom.z);
      }

      function renderPagerSettled(centerIndex = currentIndex) {
        cards.forEach(card => {
          applyCardGeom(card, level2Geom(card, centerIndex));
        });

        pagerCounter.textContent = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${cards.length}`;
        fitHandleHitArea();
      }

      /*
       * 二级滑动采用两阶段运动：
       *
       * 1. Reveal
       *    当前卡沿手指方向移开得更快；
       *    将出现卡只轻微跟随。
       *    两张 172px 高的卡最终拉开到约 190px 中心距，
       *    也就是完整露出后仍保留约 18px 空隙。
       *
       * 2. Catch-up
       *    将出现卡快速追向中央；
       *    原中央卡只补完剩余短距离。
       *
       * direction:
       *   +1 = 向上滑，下一张从下方成为中央卡
       *   -1 = 向下滑，上一张从上方成为中央卡
       */
      function renderPagerDrag(direction, travel) {
        const targetIndex = currentIndex + direction;

        if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= cards.length) {
          return;
        }

        const reveal = clamp(travel / PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE);
        const catchRaw = clamp(
          (travel - PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE) /
          (PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE - PAGER_REVEAL_DISTANCE)
        );
        const catchUp = smoothstep(catchRaw);
        const overall = smoothstep(clamp(travel / PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE));

        const currentCard = cards[currentIndex];
        const incomingCard = cards[targetIndex];

        // 与滑动方向相反一侧的相邻卡，就是本次离场卡。
        // 向上切下一张时，上方卡离场；
        // 向下切上一张时，下方卡离场。
        const outgoingIndex = currentIndex - direction;
        const outgoingCard =
          outgoingIndex >= 0 && outgoingIndex < cards.length
            ? cards[outgoingIndex]
            : null;

        /*
         * 本次切换后，新进入视野的边缘卡。
         * 它需要做离场卡的反向镜像渐显。
         */
        const enteringEdgeIndex = targetIndex + direction;
        const enteringEdgeCard =
          enteringEdgeIndex >= 0 && enteringEdgeIndex < cards.length
            ? cards[enteringEdgeIndex]
            : null;

        cards.forEach(card => {
          const from = level2Geom(card, currentIndex);
          const to = level2Geom(card, targetIndex);

          if (card === outgoingCard) {
            /*
             * 离场卡：
             * 淡化进度完全由手指拖动距离驱动。
             * travel = 0      -> shellOpacity = 1
             * travel = total  -> shellOpacity = 0
             *
             * 同时沿离场方向继续远离，并轻微向斜后方偏移。
             * 不再经过任何 visible/hidden 阈值。
             */
            const fadeProgress = clamp(
              travel / PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE
            );

            const top =
              from.top - direction * (110 * fadeProgress);

            // 向上离场轻微向右后方，向下离场镜像向左后方。
            const x =
              direction * 16 * fadeProgress;

            const scale =
              lerp(from.scale, .90, fadeProgress);

            const shellOpacity =
              1 - fadeProgress;

            // 内容维持原本相邻卡的层级透明度，
            // 再由整卡 shellOpacity 一起乘下去。
            const innerOpacity = from.opacity;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...from,
              top,
              x,
              scale,
              shellOpacity,
              innerOpacity,
              z: 2
            });
            return;
          }

          if (card === enteringEdgeCard) {
            /*
             * 进入卡：离场卡的反向镜像。
             * 拖动进度 0 → 1：
             * opacity 0 → 1
             * 从斜后方远端靠近目标相邻卡位
             * scale .90 → 正常相邻卡 scale
             */
            const enterProgress = clamp(
              travel / PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE
            );

            const finalGeom = to;

            const top =
              finalGeom.top +
              direction * (110 * (1 - enterProgress));

            const x =
              -direction * 16 * (1 - enterProgress);

            const scale =
              lerp(.90, finalGeom.scale, enterProgress);

            const shellOpacity =
              enterProgress;

            const innerOpacity =
              finalGeom.opacity;

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...finalGeom,
              top,
              x,
              scale,
              shellOpacity,
              innerOpacity,
              z: 2
            });
            return;
          }

          if (card === currentCard) {
            // 当前卡：第一阶段主要负责“让路”
            const revealTop = from.top - direction * 88;
            const top = catchRaw <= 0
              ? lerp(from.top, revealTop, reveal)
              : lerp(revealTop, to.top, catchUp);

            const opacity = catchRaw <= 0
              ? from.opacity
              : lerp(1, to.opacity, catchUp);

            const scale = catchRaw <= 0
              ? from.scale
              : lerp(1, to.scale, catchUp);

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...from,
              top,
              x: 0,
              opacity,
              scale,
              z: catchUp < .46 ? 5 : 4
            });
            return;
          }

          if (card === incomingCard) {
            // 将出现卡：第一阶段只轻微跟手 22px，
            // 第二阶段再快速追到中央。
            const revealTop = from.top - direction * 22;
            const top = catchRaw <= 0
              ? lerp(from.top, revealTop, reveal)
              : lerp(revealTop, to.top, catchUp);

            const revealOpacity = lerp(from.opacity, .76, reveal);
            const opacity = catchRaw <= 0
              ? revealOpacity
              : lerp(.76, 1, catchUp);

            const revealScale = lerp(from.scale, .97, reveal);
            const scale = catchRaw <= 0
              ? revealScale
              : lerp(.97, 1, catchUp);

            applyCardGeom(card, {
              ...from,
              top,
              x: 0,
              opacity,
              scale,
              z: catchUp < .46 ? 4 : 6
            });
            return;
          }

          // 非参与卡仅平滑让位，不抢视觉焦点
          applyCardGeom(card, {
            top: lerp(from.top, to.top, overall),
            width: lerp(from.width, to.width, overall),
            height: lerp(from.height, to.height, overall),
            opacity: lerp(from.opacity, to.opacity, overall),
            scale: lerp(from.scale, to.scale, overall),
            x: 0,
            z: overall < .5 ? from.z : to.z
          });
        });

        pagerCounter.textContent = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${cards.length}`;
      }

      function renderPagerBoundary(offset) {
        cards.forEach(card => {
          const base = level2Geom(card, currentIndex);
          applyCardGeom(card, {
            ...base,
            top: base.top + offset
          });
        });
      }

      function animatePagerTravel(direction, fromTravel, toTravel, duration, commit) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const start = performance.now();
        const from = clamp(fromTravel, 0, PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE);
        const to = clamp(toTravel, 0, PAGER_TOTAL_DISTANCE);

        function frame(now) {
          const raw = clamp((now - start) / duration);
          const eased = easeOutCubic(raw);
          const travel = lerp(from, to, eased);

          if (travel <= 0.01) {
            renderPagerSettled(currentIndex);
          } else {
            renderPagerDrag(direction, travel);
          }

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            if (commit) {
              currentIndex += direction;
            }

            renderPagerSettled(currentIndex);
            pagerDragTravel = 0;
            pagerDragDirection = 0;
            pagerMoved = false;
          }
        }

        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function animateBoundaryBack(fromOffset) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const start = performance.now();
        const duration = 200;

        function frame(now) {
          const raw = clamp((now - start) / duration);
          const offset = lerp(fromOffset, 0, easeOutCubic(raw));
          renderPagerBoundary(offset);

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            renderPagerSettled(currentIndex);
            pagerMoved = false;
          }
        }

        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function animateTransitionTo(target, duration, done) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);

        const from = transitionProgress;
        const start = performance.now();

        function frame(now) {
          const raw = clamp((now - start) / duration);
          const eased = easeOutCubic(raw);

          renderTransition(lerp(from, target, eased));

          if (raw < 1) {
            rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
          } else {
            done?.();
          }
        }

        rafId = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function settleLevel1() {
